marketing_description: The Milwaukee 3049-20 Subcompact Impact Wrench delivers 225 ft‑lb breakaway torque from a 12 V M12 2 Ah battery, with speed settings up to 3400 RPM and impact rates up to 3600 ipm through a 3/8 in square drive. Its glass‑filled nylon housing and ergonomic rubber handle in black/red provide a compact, durable package measuring 4‑1/2 in long, 2 in wide and 4.7 in deep, while the trigger switch and REDLINK PLUS intelligence manage power and protect the tool at 103 dB sound level. Integrated features such as a brushless POWERSTATE motor, REDLITHIUM battery technology, and a friction‑ring anvil support high torque output and long battery life for fastening and breakaway applications.
